reason: SCHEDULE/FEASIBILITY lens. The in-kernel part is cheap. The honest validation the idea itself requires cannot be finished and passed by 29 Sep 10:00 UTC with P >= 0.7. (1) In-kernel implementation is easy. x138 cell 4 already writes low_coords (int16, unrefined) and low_score for peaks >= 0.3 to BIOHUB_CACHE_DIR/{name}.npz (exp57b nb cell 4; DIFF.md l.72/90). A mirror branch in tools/div_insert.py plus the divinsert glue is ~3-5 h of agent work with no-op tests, and adds seconds of CPU per movie against the ~7.5 h hidden run and the 27,000 s REPAIR_DEADLINE guard. (2) The validation as described cannot run on existing data. The protocol wants gates at dump thresholds 0.9 AND 0.5 using 'friend A's B35 0.90 peak cache as the dump stand-in'. tools/recover_daughters.py uses DEFAULT_THRESHOLD 0.90 and writes peaks90/*.npz, so the cache holds only peaks >= 0.90 and the 0.5 leg does not exist. It needs a new full-frame primary pass on all 199 videos, a multi-GPU-hour job on friend A's 5070 Ti or on Kaggle (vitalii has ~0 GPU-h until 26 Sep 00:00). Either way it competes with the x138 train cache (13-16 GPU-h, sibling verdict v_divisions_divins-x138-lab-retune_schedule.json) for the 30 GPU-h week. The lab graph is exp39, not x138. x138's readmit (>= 0.965, 4 um) and gap filler (>= 0.5) already consume part of the same pool, so the stand-in does not measure the shipped base. The B35 cache sits on friend A's machine (not in this container, not in data_external), and friend A's availability is uncertain (BRIEF section 2). (3) The gate is not statistically decidable. Numbers checked: r1_hyp_divisions.notes.md l.9 gives 23 missing + 12 unscored-relink of 132. The idea's own '>2 um from any node' rule excludes the 12 (they already have a node), leaving 23 events (17%, not 27%). 44b6 holds only ~3-4 of them, and 2 44b6 divisions are double-counted across crops (CONTEXT l.1266). So 'precision >= 0.30 on EACH embryo' is evaluated on 0-3 evaluable 44b6 forks, and 'dTP >= +3' at n ~5-10 forks has a binomial CI of ~0.07-0.65 around 0.30. P(gate passes) ~0.2-0.3, matching the idea's own probability of 0.2. (4) Joint probability of a scored, gated probe: friend A delivers the peak cache (or an x138 train cache with LOWDET 0.3 exists) by ~26 Sep 18:00 (0.4-0.6) x the 0.5-leg pool obtained in time (0.6-0.8) x gate pass (0.2-0.3) x build + dummy + user OK + scoring in time given a pass (0.85) = ~0.05-0.12. Even counting only 'validation step completes by 28 Sep', it is ~0.3-0.5 < 0.7. (5) The only path with P >= 0.7 is an unvalidated blind rider. It is feasible (submit 26 Sep ~06:00-10:00 after the dummy run, scored 26 Sep ~14:00-20:00), but its effect (value verdict: ~0, -0.001..+0.001 public) is below the 0.003 LB noise. The adopt rule 'base + 0.003' would fire only on noise, and it spends one of 21 shared slots. It would also add nodes on the private embryos with no lab evidence, a confidence-trusting sub-threshold rule of the kind measured twice as lab +0.01..+0.016 -> LB 0.
